You sweep your blade in a wide arc, forcing everyone near you to give ground.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute

All creatures adjacent to you, including allies. You must be wielding a melee weapon.
Duration
Immediate.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once on your turn.
Type
Signature
Weak
deal 1 damage to each creature adjacent to you.
Standard
deal 1 damage and push each creature 1 square directly away from you.
Strong
deal 1 damage and push each creature 2 squares directly away from you. Resolve collisions normally.
